name: Weyand Wedding Cake
subtitle: By the Hobbs sisters
notes: Originally discovered and created by the Hobbs sisters for Marta and Jeff’s 2017 wedding! Buttercream is standard buttercream, flavors picked by Amy. I know it seems like a long time. Just do it!

steps.title: Bring to room temperature
steps.body: Make sure all your ingredients are room temperature.

steps.title: Mix the dry ingredients
steps.body: In a separate bowl, combine **2½ cups cake flour**, **1 tsp salt**, **½ tsp baking powder** and **½ tsp baking soda** and mix.

steps.title: Cream the butter and sugar
steps.body: In your mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, blend **1 cup butter**, **1½ cups sugar**, **1 tsp vanilla extract**, **2 Tbsp lemon juice** and **2 Tbsp grated lemon peel** at medium speed until pale and fluffy.

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.body: Add **2 whole eggs** and **3 egg yolks**, one at a time, scraping the bowl after each addition.

steps.title: Add flour and buttermilk
steps.body: Reduce speed to low and add **a cup of flour** followed by **⅓ of the buttermilk**.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.body: Repeat this 3 times, until you have incorporated all the flour and buttermilk.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pour into pans evenly and bake about 20 minutes or until a knife is inserted and when removed is clean.

steps.title: Whip the butter
steps.body: Beat **1 cup room temp butter** with paddle attachment until it turns white, about 4-5 minutes.

steps.title: Add the sugar
steps.body: Incorporate **4 cups powdered sugar**, **1 cup** at a time.

steps.title: Add the flavorings
steps.body: Add flavorings: **1 Tbsp clear vanilla extract**, **1 tsp almond extract** and **1 tsp butter flavoring**.

steps.title: Adjust the consistency
steps.body: Adjust consistency by beating in **1-2 Tbsp milk** (regular or coconut) until frosting is at the desired texture.

yields: Enough batter for two 9-inch layers, about 12 slices (estimated)
